documents.question: What are Kalettes?
documents.answer: Kalettes are Kale's rewards currency. You earn them for staying fit, and you spend them on things that help you live longer. One Kalette is worth one penny.

documents.question: How do I earn Kalettes?
documents.answer: Your Longevity Level does the work. Your level (1 to 10) is the percentage of your monthly premium you earn back in Kalettes. At Level 5, you earn 5% back. At Level 10, you earn 10% back. The fitter you are, the more you earn.

documents.question: What does "pending" mean?
documents.answer: At the start of each quarter, we forecast how many Kalettes you can earn between now and your next assessment, typically three months away. That amount shows as pending. To bank it, all you have to do is turn up and complete your next assessment. Once banked, your Kalettes are yours to spend straight away.

documents.question: What happens if I miss my assessment?
documents.answer: Your pending Kalettes aren't banked, so you lose that quarter's earnings. Complete the next assessment and you start earning again.

documents.question: What can I spend Kalettes on?
documents.answer: Head to the Kale Store. You'll find health assessments, longevity gear, sports gear and plenty more, all chosen to support your health and fitness.

documents.question: What if the Kale Store doesn't have what I want?
documents.answer: Tell us. You can request items from within the store, and we'll work on adding them soon.
